definition: Ichigo release a dark sword wave that strikes the target from afar, dealing DMG equal to 580% of ATK and inflicting 1 stack of Getsuga Mark for 5s. Tap the basic attack button when the technique hits the enemy, and Ichigo will dash to them and release a special attack. After Hollowfication, Ichigo releases a Getsuga Tensho twice in a row, dealing DMG equal to 870% of ATK with the first attack and 870% of ATK with the second.
